text:
Ana (partnerships): quick sync — target to have publisher staging ready for AWS/GCP/Azure by next Tues. open items: AMI/container packaging owner, final eula text, sku/trial mapping, hero asset for storefront. can folks call dibs?
Mike (legal): I can take EULA finalization. need the localization list from marketing though — will block if we don’t have locales. ETA EOW for base EULA. :+1:
Sara (product): i’ll own SKU <-> plan mapping and trial entitlements. i need the expected limits (concurrency, rate) from eng to map tiers.
Kevin (eng): will provide packaging guidance. question: are we doing AMI images for AWS and container images for GCP/Azure, or single OCI image everywhere?
Ana (partnerships): prefer single OCI if it passes security and image size limits. AWS team asked for an AMI option for Marketplace private AMI listing — can we produce both?
Kevin (eng): doable but doubles QA. propose OCI for initial publish, AMI follow-up in second wave. need list of required binaries and startup scripts.
Jen (ops): for publisher portal access i need names + emails of publisher admin and devops. also confirm whether terraform publisher bootstrap will be used or UI onboarding only.
Sara (product): list of admins coming later today. we should use terraform for repeatability — helps downstream customers.
Mike (legal): FYI — AWS requires a separate contract artifact for paid listings in some regions, might need signature before GM launch. tagging legal checklist: export controls, privacy addendum, support SLA pointers.
Marketplace Bot: reminder: create listing draft in publisher portal and attach manifest file: manifest.yaml, hero.png (2:1), metrics.json.
Ana (partnerships): assigning tasks: Mike = EULA + legal checklist, Sara = SKU/tiers/trial mapping, Kevin = packaging spec + manifest skeleton, Jen = publisher portal access & tf bootstrap. I’ll coordinate hero assets with marketing.
Kevin (eng): will drop a packaging spec PR in repo: repo: github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-packaging — includes sample manifest and startup script.
Sara (product): also need pricing guidance — want to align free trial length and quota. propose 14-day trial + 1000 token demo per account. thoughts?
Mike (legal): 14-day ok but check tax/regional considerations for paid conversion. will flag if risky.
Jen (ops): scheduling a 30min handoff tomorrow 11:30am PT to walk through portal steps and roles. putting invite now.
Ana (partnerships): perfect — if everyone can drop a one-line update after the meeting we can lock staging date. thanks all :rocket:
